namedBlindSpots_gateOwnHeader: 1. A store reached through a variable not named *Store (const s = getStore(); s.update(...)). CALL_RE requires an identifier ending in Store/STORE.

unprovenAxes_gateOwnWordsVerbatim: THE WIRE IS SIMULATED. Updates cross by Y.encodeStateAsUpdate/applyUpdate, not a socket. Latency, reordering, loss and server linearisation are NOT measured. `tools/ga-gate/check-collab-graph-integrity.ts` owns the transport question.
THE STORE LEG IS NOT MEASURED HERE. This gate reads the CRDT document. Whether the disclosed value reaches the authoritative store is `check-two-client-convergence`'s subject.

THE ARTEFACT IS COUNTED, NOT ITS QUALITY. That a CRDTConflict names the element and property is measured; that the DIALOG renders it, that a user can act on it, and that acting restores the value are NOT.
ONE PROBE PROPERTY PER DISPOSITION. Real payloads carry many properties and real conflicts may be multi-property; a per-property loss inside a multi-property merge is out of scope.
STRUCTURAL LOSS IS OUT OF SCOPE. This measures per-key scalar convergence. Deletes, array reorderings and the SSRIVAL-MINT container race (closed by fb7cd4a0) are different mechanisms.
ARM D IS NAME-SHAPED. A subscriber registered through an alias or a wrapper not spelled `.onConflict(` is invisible to it.
